flash_693522.description: Gaza sources claim that Ahmed al-Batsh, a commander in Hamas' military wing, was eliminated in a strike on a vehicle in Gaza City.

flash_693521.description: NATO fighter jets were scrambled in Lithuania amid concerns over a possible drone incursion into the country's airspace near Vilnius, the National Crisis Management Center said.

flash_693528.description:
Iranian news agency Fars reported that the United States struck two fishing boats in the Persian Gulf using a drone.

According to the report, several fishermen who were aboard the boats are missing.

flash_693527.description: Mahmoud Khalil sues Columbia University, alleging it failed to stop harassment of Palestinian Arab activists and retaliated against students who reported it.

flash_693525.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell returns to Capitol Hill after a three-month health-related absence, saying he is still recovering but plans to be present for key votes.

flash_693523.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says Tehran is ready for nuclear talks with Washington if the US lifts sanctions and abandons unilateral pressure.

flash_693520.description: Iran says an oil tanker struck a naval mine near the Strait of Hormuz, while CENTCOM says the vessel was hit by an Iranian missile and drone.

flash_693546.description: The incident reportedly followed an altercation that broke out inside the synagogue.

flash_693545.description: Enlisted IDF soldier stages protest outside Central Command headquarters against Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth, accusing him of persecuting Tal Yinon Derdik.

flash_693544.description: Shin Bet says Mustafa Issa exploited his work as a firefighter to identify sensitive targets and contacted Hamas terrorists and Iranian intelligence agents.

flash_693543.description: A targeted Border Police operation uncovered two Toyota vehicles stolen from central Israel.

flash_693542.description:
Gaza sources affiliated with Hamas report that Ahmed al-Batsh was eliminated overnight in an IDF drone strike on his vehicle.

According to the sources, al-Batsh served as head of the Northern Brigade’s weapons staff in Hamas and previously commanded the Jabaliya Battalion.

flash_693541.description: Five youths were seen outside Lauderdale Road Synagogue before two fireworks were launched toward the building; no injuries or damage were reported.

flash_693540.description: A new Pentagon inspector general report reveals ammunition shortages, major aircraft losses and Iranian strikes on a key US Navy hub.

flash_693539.description: Former hostage Sasha Troufanov recalls reaching a turning point in Hamas captivity, when faith helped him overcome fear and accept that his fate was in G-d’s hands.

flash_693538.description: Listen closely: the canary has already fallen silent. Opinion.

flash_693537.description: US Treasury sanctions Russia’s VTB Bank for helping Iran evade sanctions and move frozen assets, warning foreign institutions to sever ties with the bank.

flash_693536.description:
The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen announced that 13 civilians were injured in Houthi attacks on the cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif. Seven homes and two vehicles were also damaged.

Meanwhile, Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces reported advances in Al-Jawf Governorate, near the Saudi border, and said they were approaching the city of Al-Hazm in the center of the governorate.

Airstrikes were also reported against Houthi targets in and around Al-Mokha, as well as in areas of the Taiz, Lahij and Al-Dhale governorates.

flash_693535.description: Iranian Al-Alam TV reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' air defense systems intercepted a US MQ-1 drone in the airspace west of the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_693534.description: Three Jewish 14-year-olds allegedly assaulted and subjected to hate speech on a London bus as police investigate the incident as antisemitic.

flash_693533.description: US blocks an exemption allowing Iran's nuclear chief to attend an IAEA meeting, citing UN sanctions and Tehran's lack of nuclear cooperation.

flash_693532.description: Norway’s Foreign Minister says the country could impose prison terms of up to three years for trading with Israeli communities in Judea and Samaria under legislation due this fall.

flash_693531.description: President Trump nominates Texas Rep. Wesley Hunt as ambassador to Saudi Arabia as Washington pushes closer ties between Riyadh and Israel.

flash_693530.description: Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei rejects Trump's mixed signals on talks.

flash_693529.description: Patriots owner Robert Kraft confirms he helped pressure Ed Sheeran to drop Macklemore, citing antisemitic rhetoric and imagery at recent shows.

flash_693526.description:
Two 18-year-olds were moderately injured and nine other people sustained light injuries in a collision between a vehicle and a tractor on Route 8691 near the entrance to Natur.

Magen David Adom paramedics and EMTs provided medical treatment at the scene before evacuating the injured to Rambam Hospital in Haifa and Poriya Hospital in Tiberias.

flash_693524.description:
NATO fighter jets intercepted a drone that entered Lithuanian airspace near Vilnius, the country's National Crisis Management Center said.

Earlier, it was reported that the fighter jets had been scrambled to the area amid concerns over a possible drone incursion.

flash_693561.description: The Religious Zionism party has presented a comprehensive plan to overhaul the judicial system, making clear that its implementation will be a prerequisite for joining the next coalition.

flash_693560.description: Four-year-old boy from Holon is hospitalized with severe meningococcal infection; Wolfson doctor warns the disease can become life-threatening within hours.

flash_693558.description: Eilat man who never held a license allegedly fled police by car and on foot, climbed onto a school guard booth and threatened an officer and his family.

flash_693556.description: WerteInitiative urges Berlin parties to apply the same standards used to exclude the AfD to antisemitism and extremism from the Left.

flash_693555.description: IDF eliminates Hamas commander Rafat Abu Zamar, who trained terrorists ahead of October 7, and a weapons producer as Hamas worked to rebuild its capabilities.

flash_693553.description: IDI poll finds 74% of Israeli Jews fast at least partially on Yom Kippur and 57% attend synagogue, including many who rarely attend during the year.

flash_693551.description:
Police arrested another suspect on Tuesday in connection with last month’s murder of Caucasian crime boss Yanis Yoshvayev in Caesarea.

Police will seek to extend his detention in court, subject to the needs and findings of the investigation.

flash_693550.description:
Sundor, part of the El Al Group, will operate two weekly direct flights to Marrakesh, Morocco, beginning November 16, 2026, on Mondays and Wednesdays, subject to the required approvals.

Introductory fares will start at $599 for a round-trip LITE ticket, including a carry-on suitcase and personal item.

flash_693548.description: JPPI survey finds 72% of Jewish Israelis reject leaving Gaza without a security perimeter, while support for occupying the entire Strip rises to 36%.

flash_693583.description: The IDF has already begun an investigation by its Information Security Department and at several other units suspected of being sources of materials and information provided to the creators of the film “Naza."

flash_693582.description: Bar Kupershtein recounts the miraculous moment during his Gaza captivity when a canceled transfer kept him from a building later destroyed in an IDF strike.

flash_693581.description: US, Israeli and Arab military chiefs hold secret Germany meeting on ongoing conflict with Iran and broader regional tensions.

flash_693580.description: Singer says the promoter of his US tour was the one who made the decision to drop the rapper who used his appearances to bash Israel.

flash_693579.description: The Consumer Price Index rose 0.7% in August, bringing annual inflation to 1.5%, while rents continued to climb and home prices fell 1.2% year-on-year.

flash_693578.description:
Last weekend the IDF struck in the Khan Younis area in the southern Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Mohsen Farid Said Abu Hadaf, a rocket cell commander in the Islamic Jihad terrorist organization.

The terrorist infiltrated Kissufim area during the October 7th Massacre.

Recently, the terrorist advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.

The IDF stated that prior to the strike, measures were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

flash_693577.description: Former Justice Minister Ayelet Shaked criticized Netanyahu: “He bears both responsibility and blame for October 7," and offered her prediction for the elections.

flash_693576.description: ITIM petitions to disqualify Shas candidate Amos Dror, alleging he failed to meet the required 100-day cooling-off period before the elections.

flash_693575.description: Bereaved families, relatives of hostages and captivity survivors presented the “October 7 File," a document they say compiles facts about the policies and decisions that preceded the massacre.

flash_693574.description: Maj. Gen. Yaniv Asor addresses the controversy over the film 'Naza,' Israel's war against Hamas and accusations targeting the IDF, declaring: 'They will not succeed!'

flash_693573.description:
Overnight (Monday), the IDF and ISA struck in the northern Gaza Strip and eliminated the terrorist Ahmad Batash, commander of the Jabaliya Battalion in the Northern Gaza Brigade of Hamas’ military wing.

As part of his role, the terrorist was responsible for managing and organizing the Northern Gaza Brigade’s weapons and coordinated and facilitated the supply of weapons and military equipment to Hamas operatives.

Recently, the terrorist advanced terrorist attacks targeting IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire.

The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.

The IDF ststed that prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance.

flash_693572.description: Just before a conference in South America, Prof. Ron Eliashar received a call from a doctor who had trained under him: A patient with a tumor that had spread to her brain needed his help.

flash_693570.description: A Religious Zionism campaign video shows judges and the Attorney General being forcibly dragged away, sparking harsh reactions.

flash_693569.description: FTS and KSK present the new TAHR light airborne tactical vehicle to the German special forces command

flash_693568.description: State House candidate Imtiaz Mohammad campaigns at terror-related groups and mosques. Report.

flash_693567.description: Israel impeded the Two-State mania. To fit the crime, governments awarded Statehood to people who celebrated every watershed atrocity from 9/11 to Oct 7. Opinion.

flash_693566.description: Dr. Uzi Haddad of the Jerusalem College of Technology speaks to Arutz Sheva and warns that the real AI danger may not be machines turning against humanity, but humans becoming so dependent on them that they lose the ability to think for themselves.

flash_693565.description: They both fought implacable enemies, loved their country, and loved cigars, but only one had to face a trial for accepting them, this while fighting an existential war on several fronts. Opinion.

flash_693564.description: The Union of Journalists defended the film's creators amid threats and violent reactions, prompting sharp criticism from journalists Amit Segal and Noam Amir.

flash_693563.description: A spiritual decline does not necessarily begin with a major decision or a dramatic break with the past. Sometimes it begins with something small, almost too small to notice. Only later do we see where that change has led.

flash_693562.description: Authorities did not renew the license for the cemetery purchased by the Jewish community. Four graves were relocated with the assistance of ZAKA and in accordance with Jewish law.

flash_693559.description: Military Police open an investigation after an NCO-course soldier shot a Palestinian in the leg during a confrontation.

flash_693557.description:
An Iranian government aircraft, generally used to transport senior officials in Tehran, landed in Saudi Arabia on Tuesday.

The landing has drawn attention amid regional developments and tensions, particularly because the aircraft is associated with travel by senior Iranian officials.

No official information has yet been released regarding who was aboard, the purpose of the visit, or whether it involves a diplomatic or security mission. The identities of the Iranian officials who arrived in the kingdom also remain unknown.

flash_693554.description: A new investigation exposes Nazi gestures, threats, assaults and shocking antisemitic abuse in Britain's public health system.

flash_693593.description: IDF confirms: Rafah Brigade commander and head of Hamas’s Operations Directorate eliminated

flash_693592.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the IDF and Shin Bet elimination of the Rafah Brigade commander in southern Gaza.

“The policy that the Prime Minister and I are leading, and that the IDF is carrying out in the most professional and appropriate manner, is clear: We eliminate terrorists and remove threats, and we do not target civilians or uninvolved people - contrary to the blood libel fabricated by the makers of the film ‘NAZA,’ directed against our heroic soldiers. No terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not remain in Gaza," Katz said.

flash_693591.description: Captivity survivor Rom Braslavski spoke with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and admitted that despite their disagreements, he is very apprehensive about giving his vote to the left.

flash_693590.description: What does it mean, to remember not to forget? In Judaism, the paradox of “remembering not to forget" is anchored in the dual command regarding the biblical nation of Amalek.

flash_693589.description: Netanyahu and Katz declare, 'No terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not remain in Gaza,' after IDF and Shin Bet strike a senior Hamas terrorist believed to be the Rafah Brigade commander.

flash_693588.description: In standing up to Macklemore and declaring, “I was born a Jew," Pink did something painfully rare in today’s entertainment world: she refused to abandon her people when supporting Jews became unfashionable.

flash_693587.description: The IDF and ISA struck a senior Hamas terrorist in the southern Gaza Strip

flash_693586.description: Rabbi Teichtal the Gra, Rav Kook and the Ohr Sameach on aliya.

flash_693585.description: Following a Saudi request to the United States, Israel has begun providing intelligence to Riyadh through Washington, based on the view that the Houthi threat is a regional problem.

flash_693584.description: Israel’s UN ambassador calls on countries to skip the event marking 25 years since the Durban Conference, saying there is “no reason to celebrate" its legacy of antisemitism and anti-Israel incitement.

flash_693571.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

flash_693600.description:
The Central Elections Committee will consider next week requests to disqualify lists and candidates from running in the elections to the 26th Knesset.

Three requests have been filed to disqualify the Ra’am party, two requests to disqualify Otzma Yehudit, one request to disqualify the Democrats party, one request to disqualify the Religious Zionist Party, one request to disqualify the Joint List and MK Ofer Cassif, and another request to disqualify former MK Sami Abu Shehadeh.

flash_693599.description: The Otzma Yehudit party petitions the Central Elections Committee to disqualify former MK Sami Abu Shehadeh from running in the upcoming Knesset elections.

flash_693598.description: According to reports in Lebanon, two strikes were carried out in the Al-Qantara area of southern Lebanon.

flash_693597.description: According to reports in Iran, several explosions were heard near Qeshm Island, located close to the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_693596.description: Vice President JD Vance says the US-Iran conflict will enter a “much different phase" within months as Washington pressures Tehran and restores traffic through Hormuz.

flash_693595.description:
Dozens of bereaved families and the B'Tsalmo organization have submitted a petition to the Central Elections Committee seeking to disqualify MK Ofer Cassif of the Joint List from running in the elections for the 26th Knesset.

Adv. Eldad Rabinowitz, a member of the Central Elections Committee representing the Noam party, joined the petition and is also representing the petitioners alongside Adv. Yehuda Pua.

flash_693594.description: In the recording, Keshet can be heard trying to call for medical assistance, describing the severe pain he was suffering and the paralyzing fear that left him unable to move.

flash_693609.description: Bereaved father Dedi Simchi launches a fierce attack against the creators of the anti-Israel documentary “NAZA".

flash_693608.description: 21-year-old Pennsylvania man with a history of extremist activity as a juvenile charged after authorities say he obtained a rifle for an alleged ISIS attack.

flash_693607.description: US House votes for a third time to end Trump's Iran war, with seven Republicans joining Democrats ahead of the November midterm elections.

flash_693605.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz urges Iran to end the Hormuz blockade, halt its nuclear program and prevent the conflict from spreading into Iraq.

flash_693603.description: US urges Americans to reconsider travel to Saudi Arabia, citing missile and drone threats from Iran and the Houthis.

flash_693601.description: The Trump administration is preparing a $2.8 billion military package for Israel, according to a US official.

flash_693621.description: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree rejects Saudi accusations, insisting Yemen is targeting oil facilities and military bases and that the Islamic holy sites are not under threat.

flash_693620.description: On Yom Kippur, we make a principled declaration: Our true essence is spiritual.

flash_693619.description: First-of-its-kind study finds more than 70% of participants completed a 25-hour fast without significant complications, with advance pump adjustments increasing the likelihood of success eightfold.

flash_693618.description: Division, corruption, selfishness and short-term thinking inevitably impoverish a society. Responsibility, trust, discipline and shared purpose allow it to prosper. Opinion.

flash_693616.description: Three aspects of the 4-month-long IDF operation, an operation carefully kept under the radar, are what makes its success so significant. Op-ed.

flash_693614.description: New CAM analysis finds hundreds of viral posts blaming Jews and Israel for the September 11 attacks as conspiracy theories spread across major social media platforms.

flash_693612.description: A documentary in production features testimony from longtime employees who worked alongside Sara Netanyahu, including office chief Tzipi Navon, who claims she was offered money to speak against the Netanyahu family.

flash_693610.description: Journalist Nate Friedman confronted an NYC parking inspector about discrimination in enforcement during times of Islamic prayer in the city.

flash_693606.description: National Security Minister speaks about his political future, his leadership qualities, and what he believes he still lacks.

flash_693604.description: Ofer Winter claimed that rivals tried to dismantle his party, threaten his staff, and hire private investigators. Likud demands a retraction and is threatening a libel suit.

flash_693602.description: Finneas and other artists withdraw from Ed Sheeran's tour after Macklemore was dropped following his pro-Palestinian Arab remarks at a concert.

flash_693637.description: At memorial ceremony for fallen Arabic-speaking Christian IDF soldiers, Netanyahu rejects claims Israel persecutes minorities and calls the country an ‘island of tolerance.’

flash_693636.description: Alexander Granovsky documented power stations and Benny Gantz’s neighborhood, set fire to nine vehicles, and received thousands of dollars from an Iranian agent. He has now been sentenced.

flash_693634.description: The Civil Administration removed dozens of illegal structures and encroachments near two new communities in Judea and Samaria.

flash_693632.description:
Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz toured Ma’ale Adumim and said the E1 corridor, which he said connects the city to Jerusalem, is “an important strategic security asset and an integral part of Jerusalem’s future infrastructure."

He added that the Jerusalem perimeter should receive a comprehensive national response as part of the capital’s metropolitan area.

flash_693631.description: The National Security Minister visited Bir Hadaj and confronted residents during the demolition of illegal structures. “Anyone who breaks the law will encounter the enforcement authorities."

flash_693630.description: Reuters reports US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman, where the terror group pledged not to attack American or Israeli vessels.

flash_693629.description: Police investigating threats against prominent Munich Holocaust survivor and AfD opponent Charlotte Knobloch.

flash_693627.description: Yonatan Yosef says a Supreme Court ruling blocking a state memorial conference for his grandfather wrongly shifts authority from elected officials to the legal establishment.

flash_693625.description: We're losing the game. It's time to start playing by their rules. Op-ed.

flash_693623.description: Senior commander living on Gaza border reveals terrifying October 7 dilemma as Shin Bet fighters raced to save families before reaching her.

flash_693617.description: Study of more than 1.2 million Israelis finds kibbutz residents have significantly lower mortality risk than haredi and non-haredi Jews living in urban communities.

flash_693615.description: Phuket authorities order a seven-day investigation into Chabad of Patong, examining land ownership and licenses days after a Rosh Hashanah event for 2,000 Israelis was called off due to security concerns.

flash_693611.description: Three killed as news helicopter crashes in flames while covering a fatal accident; veteran anchor breaks down on air: 'We’ve lost contact with our people.'

flash_693647.description: Netanyahu announces bills to revoke citizenship from those who slander IDF soldiers and increase potential defamation damages twentyfold following NAZA controversy.

flash_693646.description: IDF says three terrorists were involved in planting explosives, planning shooting attacks and launching rockets at Israel; strikes carried out to remove immediate threats.

flash_693645.description: Hanan Ben Ari released a live version of “Hashivenu" from his “Hindikim" performance and shared his excitement over the song’s journey: “I discover again and again how little I understand."

flash_693643.description: Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir visits 91st Division, says IDF will maintain forward defensive positions inside enemy territory and prevent Hezbollah from rebuilding its capabilities.

flash_693641.description: Shepherd from Tzon Aviezer discovers a monument honoring a terrorist linked to the Emanuel bus massacre; residents demand the IDF demolish it.

flash_693639.description: Umm al-Fahm man indicted for allegedly torching a motorcycle during a divorce-related dispute; police say he accidentally set himself on fire during the arson.

flash_693635.description: Karmeli Brigade reservists say they left families, jobs and businesses for 100 days of duty, only to face early release because funding was not approved.

flash_693633.description: Yashar! party denies claim following meeting with northern Bedouin leaders: 'These things were never said, not even by implication.'

flash_693628.description: Asked by Channel 13 which government representatives showed up during the darkest months of fighting in the north, Yossi Levit had one name he kept coming back to.

flash_693626.description: Ashdod mezuzah and tefillin inspection campaign finds erased words, damaged letters, in alarming quantity of parchments.

flash_693622.description: Monthly rallies, now drawing hundreds of participants, are commanding real media attention. Opinion.

flash_693654.description: We ask Hashem for the blessing of being able to be clever, so that we can use our wisdom to cope well in this world.

flash_693653.description:
The National Cyber Directorate is warning about phishing messages containing a link to a website impersonating Booking and asking users to confirm a hotel reservation.

The Directorate recommends not clicking the link and instead checking the reservation directly through the official website or app.

flash_693652.description: A LAW missile stolen from the IDF fired at a residential complex in Kafr Qasim. No injuries reported. Police launch a manhunt for suspects.

flash_693651.description: Chabad emissary Rabbi Tzemach Mizrahi assaulted near a Milan bus stop by three men who stole his hat and kicked him. Italian police arrest all three suspects.

flash_693650.description: A Kansas man was arrested after allegedly making multiple antisemitic death threats against Jewish right-wing podcaster Ben Shapiro, including an ominous countdown to Yom Kippur.

flash_693649.description: Images provided to CBS by US military personnel reveal damage caused to military bases and American property at several sites across the Middle East by Iranian strikes.

flash_693648.description: Amit Segal highlights the irony of Saudi Arabia reportedly seeking Israeli intelligence against the Houthis after years of publicly criticizing Israel.

flash_693644.description: IDF releases new footage from Hezbollah tunnels in the Ali Taher Ridge, where troops uncovered and destroyed strategic terrorist infrastructure.

flash_693642.description: The Ministerial Committee on Shin Bet Affairs decided to authorize the Shin Bet to determine security arrangements for party leaders who do not hold positions entitling them to protection. The authorization will remain in effect until the 26th Knesset is sworn in.

flash_693640.description: Helmet cameras captured Duvdevan soldiers during a special operation in Burqin, in which a senior member of the Jenin terrorist network was arrested.

flash_693638.description: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba commander Jihad Ismail, who infiltrated Israel on October 7 and took part in the deadly attack on Tank No. 3 and abduction of its crew.

flash_693658.description:
The Houthi-affiliated Al-Masirah channel reported that Saudi Arabia carried out two airstrikes targeting the Al-Barah Bridge in the Makbanah area of Taiz province in southwestern Yemen.

According to the report, this is the second time in two days that the bridge has been targeted.

flash_693657.description: President Trump says Iran “very much" wants a deal as he signals the war may be nearing its end and confirms direct contact with Tehran.

flash_693656.description: Lebanese media reported overnight that strikes were carried out in the villages of Al-Qantara, Al-Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, and Al-Mansouri, as well as in the Wadi Al-Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

flash_693655.description: Bipartisan US senators urge the Trump administration to release classified details of proposed Saudi nuclear deal, including two “side letters."

flash_693673.description: Those 600 trucks of aid that enter the Gaza Strip each day should go to the Druze, not to Hamas. Opinion.

flash_693672.description: The film's creators did not have to work very hard to discover the real truth, but the results show that they did not even try - or, even worse, that they deliberately misrepresented it. Opinion.

flash_693670.description: LA Federation sues museum for custody of looted paintings once hoarded by Hermann Göring.

flash_693668.description: Balad attacks Otzma Yehudit’s attempt to bar Sami Abu Shehadeh from running, calling it a "campaign of incitement and political persecution."

flash_693666.description: Air Canada removes an in-flight service director from service and launches an investigation after antisemitic social media posts about Israel surfaced.

flash_693664.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar meets Moroccan counterpart and the two agree to upgrade Israel-Morocco ties, expand flights and appoint ambassadors by the end of 2026.

flash_693662.description: Likud loses another seat, falling to 18, while Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar remains in first place. Netanyahu’s coalition bloc rises to 54 seats, overtaking the Eisenkot bloc.

flash_693660.description: The State Department confirmed on Wednesday night that it has refused to issue entry visas to Palestinian Authority (PA) chairman Mahmoud Abbas and members of his delegation ahead of next week’s United Nations General Assembly in New York.
